usedFor: MyDocSafe collects forms and signatures and Keka runs HR, so “Form is submitted” can run “Add an new employee”.

bestTemplate.name: “Form is submitted” in MyDocSafe, then “Add an new employee” in Keka
bestTemplate.why: A submitted form can carry the personal details, so the new employee exists in Keka without retyping.

watchOut: “Add an new employee” takes personal details, job assignment and salary, so the form must collect all three.
